articles.title: Zack Snyder Says 300 Is the ‘Gayest Movie Ever Made,' Defends The Last Photograph Amid Online Backlash
articles.summary: Zach Snyder is going viral off the heels of his latest movie, The Last Photograph, as well as his subsequent interview with Variety where he responded to the backlash against the film and made a few eyebrow-raising remarks about his previous work.
body: Reviews for Snyder’s The Last Photograph have been brutal. A swath of scathing opinions hit the net after its screening at the Toronto International Film Festival over the weekend, where Snyder joked that the audience in attendance might be the only ones to ever see it on the silver screen — and based on critical reception to the project, that might be a legitimate possibility.

For example, IGN gave the bloody action flick a 4 out of ten, calling it a “trudging revenge saga that points to self-critique” that’s “filled with big ideas that go nowhere.” Discourse online, however, has been far more vitriolic. According to Snyder himself, users on social media have been labeling him a “fascist” and a “homophobe” in the wake of these scalding reviews.

“Look, I’m famously surrounded by a particular discourse that happens around my movies. It’s incredibly charged. And I thought, for the smallest of moments, that because it’s a small movie and it’s really not that big of a deal, that it’d be allowed to exist on whatever level it is. What kind of noise does a tiny movie like this warrant from the world?” he said in a September 15 interview with Variety.

articles.title: The Last Of Us Season 3 Is Probably The Final Season, HBO Says Yet Again
articles.summary: HBO boss Casey Bloys has once again said that the upcoming third season of The Last of Us is expected to be its last. He told Deadline that Season 3 is coming in 2027, though did not confirm when in the year.
body: In January this year, Bloys was asked if Season 3 is going to be the last, and he said, "It certainly seems that way." However, at the time, Bloys admitted that a decision like that would come down to Mazin.
Before this, Mazin said that Season 4 was essential to bring the show to a conclusion. However, Bloys has indicated that the show may wrap up its run with Season 3, which could be a longer season.
“Craig is still working it out whether it will be two more seasons or one more long season. It hasn’t been decided yet, and I’m following Craig’s lead on that,” Bloys said in 2025.

In a big shift for the series, franchise creator Naughty Dog is not involved creatively in Season 3, and Neil Druckmann dropped out as a writer/director. People have speculated about what this could mean, but Druckmann, for his part, said he left the show to focus on his work on Naughty Dog's games.

articles.title: The 2026 AOVOPRO 48V 500W Electric Scooter with 22-Mile Range and 22mph Top Speed Drops to $122
articles.summary: There are many reasons why an electric scooter might be a better fit for you than an electric bike. They're lighter, more compact, and usually less expensive. Electric assisted scooters give you more range and speed for less effort, and the brushless motor is pretty quiet.
body: During its Fall Sale, AliExpress is offering the new 2026 AOVOPRO 48V 500W electric scooter with 10.5Ah battery for just $121.60 with free shipping after coupon: " FSUS15 ". AliExpress marketplace vendor AOVOPRO is the official manufacturer of this scooter. It's stocked in a local US warehouse and usually delivers within a week with no additional import fees.

The AOVOPRO scooter has nearly the same amount of power as entry-level electric bikes. For starters, it's equipped with a powerful 500W brushless motor that can push the scooter at speeds of up to 22mph and a 48V 10.5Ah battery that lasts up to 22 miles on a single charge and the torque to climb steep inclines. The 10" tires and dual suspension allows the AOVOPRO to tackle rougher terrain versus the single suspension models with 8" tires that are restricted to smooth paved surfaces. The scooter weighs about 35 pounds and can be folded for easier transport and storage.

articles.title: Casino Royale Is Returning to Theaters for the Film's 20th Anniversary
articles.summary: Daniel Craig's first James Bond film, Casino Royale, is returning to theaters very soon for the film's 20th anniversary. Amazon MGM Studios confirmed the news today with a poster confirming that the iconic 007 film will return to theaters worldwide this October.
body: Casino Royale was a watershed moment for the Bond franchise, as the Pierce Brosnan era largely crashed and burned by the end of its run. The series was seeking something that could modernize and refresh itself for audiences, leading to a more grounded, gritty, and raw take on the MI6 spy. Despite doubts that he could pull it off, Craig turned in a captivating performance that was both charming and intimidating. Perhaps even more notably, he gave Bond a bit more depth than ever before, and the filmmakers took advantage of his vibrant blue eyes for some really emotional moments toward the end of the film.

Casino Royale kicked off a legendary five-film run for Craig, and although not all of them were slam dunks, they cleaned up at the box office and revitalized a character that some fans had begun to count out. Craig's time as 007 came to an end in 2021 with No Time to Die, and now, all eyes are on the future of the character. Amazon is actively developing the next Bond film with director Denis Villeneuve, with an expectation that it will shoot shortly after he finishes Dune Part 3.
points: Daniel Craig's first James Bond film, Casino Royale, is returning to theaters very soon for the film's 20th anniversary.

articles.title: Target Will Be Unusually Strict For Pokémon's 30th Anniversary TCG Set Release
articles.summary: You can buy Pokémon cards nearly anywhere these days, but most people in the United States default to buying TCG products at Target stores. Target, it seems, is taking that association seriously for the impending launch of the Pokémon 30th Anniversary set.
body: Target customers may already have noticed this change. Throughout September, many Target locations have set up elaborate Pokémon product displays near the electronics section in the back of the store. According to leaked documentation, these shelves won't be limited to 30th Anniversary items — fans should also expect to see recent products, like the new Target-exclusive Pokémon Owala bottles.

The retailer is apparently increasing its security measures around the release as well. The exact rules will vary by location, and fans who plan on lining up early might do well to check with their local store. However, as first reported by Pokémon restock influencer BritBrattv, Pokémon fans should expect a stricter sales system for the 30th Anniversary products. Many stores will make use of added security personnel to manage potentially long and unruly lines, and to direct parking lot traffic.

articles.title: After riffing on Theme Hospital, Two Point Museum studio is tipping a hat to Bullfrog's classic Theme Park in its next DLC
articles.summary: Well this made me chuckle. After starting out with Two Point Hospital - a spiritual successor to developer Bullfrog Productions' classic sick-fixing sim Theme Hospital, Two Point Studios is now going even further into the past.
body: Two Point Studios actually has a direct link to Bullfrog Productions if you weren't aware: its founders, Mark Webley and Gary Carr, previously worked at the sadly long-defunct developer, and did, in fact, work on 1994's Theme Park. So there's a fun bit of symmetry going on here.

Anyway, Rides & Relics is the latest in Two Point Museum's run of largely excellent DLC expansions; those previous releases offering some neat shake-ups to the museum-running formula by introducing the likes of zoo animals, art appreciation, and even a spin on D&D-style tabletop fantasy. And, this time, the twist is theme parks and funfairs.

By sending your new Funfair Experts out to explore the new Gearbox Fairground expedition map, you'll uncover new blueprints and perks unlocking "17+" funfair-themed exhibits, including interactive displays and antique amusements (the trailer includes the likes of a pirate ship, haunted house, ferris wheel, popcorn stand, candyfloss stall, teacup ride and, um, cheese flume). It's also possible to build your own mini-coasters - adjusting height, tilt and camber - with talk of five unique coaster themes.

articles.title: 'Apex Legends' Is Officially Crossing Over With Fall’s Most-Anticipated Action Movie
articles.summary: Electronic Arts has revealed that the battle royale shooter Apex Legends ' next big crossover will bring Street Fighter 6 's cast into a completely different sort of competition. The event begins next week, one month before Street Fighter hits the big screen in its new film adaptation.
body: As revealed in an official blog post on the Apex Legends website, the event is titled Apex Legends vs Street Fighter 6, evoking classic titles like Marvel vs. Capcom. The event will begin on Sept. 22 and run through Oct. 13. The main event of the crossover will be the Wildcard game mode that turns the battle royale into an all-out brawl. Rather than shoot at each other, players will pick from four Street Fighter characters and use melee attacks to take down enemies. Collecting coins will fill a Fighter Gauge that lets you enter Fighter Form, which unlocks more special abilities.

The mode will take place on a remixed version of the Olympus map, full of nods to Capcom's series. The final round will be called Showdown and will grant the remaining players an infinite Fight Gauge so that everyone can end the game on an explosive note.

Each skin costs 2,150 Apex Coins. In addition to the character skins, there will be eight weapon skins, two skydive emotes, holosprays, stickers, badges, trackers, and frames. Players will earn Zenny in every match, which can be used to unlock items. One such item will be an Epic skin for Lifeline that makes her look like Street Fighter's Li-Fen.
points: Electronic Arts has revealed that the battle royale shooter Apex Legends ' next big crossover will bring Street Fighter 6 's cast into a completely different sort of competition.

articles.title: What time does Black Ops 7 Season 6 start in your time zone?
articles.summary: The Black Ops 7 Season 6 start time is almost here, marking the start of the final season before Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 arrives. As has been the case with every season during Black Ops 7 's lifespan, Season 6 is packed to the brim with new content, mostly themed around the spooky season…
body: Here are all the details on when Black Ops 7 Season 6 starts in your time zone and what to expect from the new season.

Black Ops 7 Season 6 marks the beginning of The Haunting, which brings plenty of spooky content to the FPS game's multiplayer, zombies, and endgame modes, alongside Warzone. There are two new 6v6 maps coming in the form of Quantum and Bloodstead, a horror-themed variant of the Homestead map.

More excitingly, three maps based on locations from the zombies mode are coming to multiplayer as part of a new limited-time mode called T.E.D.D. Trials: Roadkill is part of the Exit 115 map, Inferno is from Kowakujo, and Lost is from Totenreich. Meanwhile, in the zombies mode, a new survival map called Tenshu is coming, while directed mode and starting room are coming to Rex Infernus.

In endgame, Avalon is now set at night, bringing new enemy types, and the "Forbidden Summoning" event is taking place, which looks like a colossal ancient worm boss. In Warzone, Haven's Hollow is becoming Haunted Hollow, with numerous changes throughout the map, including a ghost train.

articles.title: "What would a WoW 2 give you that World of Warcraft: Forever isn't already giving you?" - Blizzard addresses the MMO elephant in the room
articles.summary: Blizzard's decision to reveal far-away release dates for Diablo 5 (2029) and the new open-world StarCraft shooter (2030) at this year's BlizzCon represented an uncharacteristically transparent look at its future plans.
body: Debatably, we did. Blizzard announced World of Warcraft: Forever, colloquially known as Classic Plus, a sort of alternate-reality take on the 2004/5 launch version of World of Warcraft - one that's expanded and remastered to provide a familiar but different experience. And that's a big deal: it's a notable moment in WoW's near 22-year history.

WoW: Forever reimagines the vanilla WoW experience with new zones, expanded original zones, new dungeons, new raids, new skill and talents, new race and class combinations, a new playable race - the Skyborne - a new battleground, and 100 new quests. There are new items and rewards, new things for professions, new reputation rewards, and account-wide perks. The graphics have also hugely improved, and there's an SD/HD character toggle to flick between the old and new looks while you play.

articles.title: Diablo 4 player discovers secret Diablo 2 easter egg in its new throwback season and now everyone is wondering what else Blizzard hid in there
articles.summary: While server issues stalled the start of Diablo 4's new season for many players, a few were able to get in and discover something Blizzard carefully left out from official materials. The focus for Diablo 4's Season of Hell's Legacy is celebrating the series' 30th anniversary.
body: Blizzard didn't indicate that it would be doing more than just a nostalgic storyline for season 15—but it is. Diablo 4 streamer Dioxide was able to squeeze past the login issues and found a number of new Runes available. Normally, these slot into your gear and give you passive bonuses, but Dioxide discovered there's more to them than that.

When he dropped two specific runes and a low-quality chestpiece into Diablo 4's crafting table, the Horadric Cube, it showed "???" as the recipe instead of one of the many listed on the side of the interface. When he clicked the transmute button, out popped the Stealth chestpiece, a Unique item from Diablo 2.

It turns out Blizzard added some of the Rune word item recipes from Diablo 2 without telling anyone. The Stealth armor is created exactly as people did more than two decades ago. It has different stats than the original, but carries the same relative power in Diablo 4 because it has two more stats than a normal Unique.

The Ironclad Democracy Warbond for Helldivers 2 is launching on September 22 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
